finding.title: Admin sessions are said to last 30 minutes
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds admin sessions that last 30 minutes, because `A session expires after 30 minutes without activity.` (S:10), and that is wrong because admin sessions must end after 15 minutes.

e1.text: A session expires after 30 minutes without activity.
e1.context:
R4. An admin can do everything an editor can do and can also delete documents and manage users.

## 2. Sessions
R5. A session expires after 30 minutes without activity.
R6. After expiry the user must sign in again before any further request is accepted.
R7. Admin sessions expire after 15 minutes without activity.
